summary: A shopper who paid a deposit before repeal still has a deadline for bringing back the bottles.
realLife: Delaware kept a consumer redemption window through January 2011 after the deposit system changed in December.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: prior deposit and consumer sunset date.

turns.what: The clerk accepts an eligible old empty while the transition claim is live.
turns.pulledBy: The old container meets the dealer’s eligibility requirements before the deadline.
turns.writesBack: The dealer records the customer refund.

turns.what: Once the statutory window closes, that same old deposit no longer obliges the dealer to pay.
turns.pulledBy: The same request arrives after the final consumer deadline.
turns.writesBack: The store explains the expired claim.
